DejaVu Sans
===========

Embedded in every PDF that Z Privacy saves (046/O), and shipped in the
bundle as data/flutter_assets/assets/fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf — 759,720 bytes,
sha256 ae7b7855e115a5966d8b1b3f80f254ccc117ec86f9965e202ee2940453837280.

A PDF with no embedded font promises Helvetica and gets whatever the reader
happens to have: a, o, u with umlauts, the Nordic letters and ss come out
as the wrong letter or as nothing at all, and the file would be lying about
its own text. DejaVu Sans was chosen because it carries Latin, the Nordic
letters, Greek, Cyrillic -- and Arabic, so one file will still answer when the
Arabic pack lands. The glyphs being present is not the same as Arabic working:
the writer sets no text direction, so an Arabic line would come out mirrored
today. That is a later item, and the font is chosen now so it is not two.

What reaches a saved PDF is a subset: only the glyphs that text uses. The
name "DejaVu" contains neither "Bitstream" nor "Vera", so the renaming
clause below is not engaged by subsetting.

Upstream: https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/
Authors:  Stepan Roh and others; see the project's own AUTHORS file.
